integrity: Seven complete UTF-8 files carry a proof, source comparisons and standalone symbolic/numerical diagnostics. Finite diagnostics are not mathematical certification. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The joint weak limit concerns completed-flight end-to-end displacement and its duration, with frictionless Brownian acceleration, zero initial/reset velocity, independent homogeneous Poisson resets, fixed D,r>0. Not a trajectory maximum, within-cycle supremum or finite-time confidence guarantee. Earlier one-cycle area tail is credited, not claimed new.
title: Independent Gumbel and Gaussian clocks for extreme velocity-reset Brownian flights
